newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico VAT revs rise after crackdown on evasion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico VAT revs rise after crackdown on evasion.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry said on Sunday that value-added tax (IVA) receipts rose by an average of 7.1 percent from July to November this year.
The Ministry said in a statement that the trend of large-scale evasion had been turned around, mainly due to a crackdown on tax dodgers.
Value-added tax revenues had fallen by an annualized average of 31.5 percent in the first quarter of the year, it said.
